title: tidy --apply deletes a recorded scratch or sandbox path outside its own directory, and the target of a recorded symlink
goal: tidy lists a recorded scratch or sandbox path as remove only when it lies inside that class's own directory (a checkout of this clone's scratch_dir for scratch, the bench multi sandbox root for a sandbox) and holds no worktree of this repository, never the checkout itself or a path inside its tracked tree; a recorded symlink is not followed: own stores the link's own path, and --apply re-checks with lstat that the path it removes is the recorded directory and no symlink, so a symlink's target outside the clone is never deleted

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, tempfile, json
T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
own = lambda p, cls: tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", p, "--class", cls)
inside = os.path.join(C, "kb")
real = os.path.join(T, "real"); os.makedirs(real); open(os.path.join(real, "keep.txt"), "w").write("x")
scratch = os.path.join(C, "_cache", "scratch"); os.makedirs(scratch)
link = os.path.join(scratch, "ST-linkedxx"); os.symlink(real, link)
legit = os.path.join(scratch, "ST-legitxxx"); os.makedirs(legit); open(os.path.join(legit, "f"), "w").write("x")
own(inside, "scratch"); own(link, "scratch"); own(legit, "scratch")
rows = json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", "--older-than", "0").stdout)
rows = rows["rows"] if isinstance(rows, dict) else rows
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
v = {n(x["path"]): x.get("verdict") for x in rows if "path" in x}
assert v.get(n(legit)) == "remove", ("the control: a recorded scratch directory under the scratch dir is not removable", v)
assert v.get(n(inside)) != "remove", ("a recorded scratch path inside the checkout's tracked tree is removable", v)
assert v.get(n(real)) != "remove", ("a symlink's target outside the clone is removable", v)
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--apply", "--older-than", "0", ok=(0, 1))
assert os.path.isdir(inside) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(real, "keep.txt")), "tidy --apply deleted a path outside its own directories"

notes: Filed 2026-10-20 from the SP-ipeewrlv review (S1): the reviewer planted own <main>/kb --class scratch, own <tidy worktree>/_tools --class sandbox and a scratch record of a directory holding an unrecorded worktree, and each listed as would remove; a symlink record became its target. Premise run on origin/main: the repro and check 0 both fail (kb, the symlink target and the worktree holder are remove; the control scratch dir is remove as it should be).
